rationale: The position was entered based on a reclamation of the 9-EMA ($10.11), but the price has immediately failed to hold that level and is currently trading at $10.06. Given the broader market weakness (SPY -0.92%) and the failure to maintain the momentum required for the gap-fill trade, the risk of testing the $9.87 support level has increased significantly. Exiting now preserves capital and avoids holding through a potential breakdown of the daily low.
